This is a Selenium Java 11 framework using POM, high-level actions, and OOP. Use best practices for test automation and code organization.

# Copilot Customization Instructions

- Use Java 11, Selenium, TestNG, and WebDriverManager.
- Follow the Page Object Model (POM) pattern.
- Use OOP principles and high-level actions in Page Objects.
- Place Page Objects in `src/main/java/com/example/selenium/pages`.
- Place utilities in `src/main/java/com/example/selenium/utils`.
- Place tests in `src/test/java/com/example/selenium/tests`.
- Use `DriverManager` for WebDriver lifecycle.
- Use `BasePage` for common page logic.
- Write clear, maintainable, and reusable code.
